content: We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve IR spectra or NMR to infer carbonyls. But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is "the compound at hand" which is implicit. We need to determine carbonyl count using IR (C=O stretch) or carbon NMR (signals around 190-210 ppm). The cheapest is IR spectra. Use ir_spectra tool to get IR data, then count carbonyl peaks (~1700 cm-1). Let's call ir_spectra.
